verdict.rationale: Databricks is a data platform rather than an agent, so the official MCP server axis applies. First-party docs describe managed MCP servers hosted on Databricks, built-in system.ai MCP Services, and instructions for connecting external clients such as Claude, Cursor and MCP Inspector to those servers. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an external agent connecting, and detailed evidence of which tools the managed servers expose and how authentication works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Wire up Claude, Cursor, MCP Inspector, and other external clients to MCP servers hosted on Databricks.
Discover, authenticate to, and call managed, MCP Service, and custom MCP servers from your agent code
through built-in system.ai MCP Services, external MCP servers you register
Model Context Protocol (MCP) lets your agent query data, search documents, and call external services.
